def solve(case):
    edges = case['edges']
    refinement = case['refinement']
    # Build members
    members = {}
    for node, comm in refinement.items():
        members.setdefault(comm, []).append(node)
    for comm in members:
        members[comm].sort()
    # Aggregate edges
    agg = {}
    for u, v, w in edges:
        cu = refinement[u]
        cv = refinement[v]
        if cu > cv:
            cu, cv = cv, cu
        key = (cu, cv)
        agg[key] = agg.get(key, 0) + w
    # Convert to list and sort
    aggregate_edges = sorted([[k[0], k[1], v] for k, v in agg.items()], key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
    return {'members': members, 'aggregate_edges': aggregate_edges}
